title: A BILL FOR AN ACT Relating to prohibitions for certain products; creating new provisions; and amending ORS 459.995
provenance: SECTION 1. As used in sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act: ... Be It Enacted by the People of the State of Oregon:

location.provenance: The Senate Bill 543 is sponsored by Senators SOLLMAN, DEMBROW, Representative DEXTER and is a bill enacted by the People of the State of Oregon.

reference.provenance: Sponsored by Senators SOLLMAN, DEMBROW, Representative DEXTER (Presession filed.)

sections.value: A food vendor may not use a polystyrene foam container in selling, offering for sale, serving or dispensing prepared food to a consumer.
sections.provenance: A food vendor may not use a polystyrene foam container in selling, offering for sale, serving or dispensing prepared food to a consumer.

sections.value: A food vendor may not provide to a consumer a foodware container that is intended for a single use unless the foodware container: (a) Is made from fiber-based materials; (b) Has been certified as compostable under section 5 of this 2023 Act; or (c) Is included on the uniform statewide collection list established under ORS 459A.914.
sections.provenance: A food vendor may not provide to a consumer a foodware container that is intended for a single use unless the foodware container: (a) Is made from fiber-based materials; (b) Has been certified as compostable under section 5 of this 2023 Act; or (c) Is included on the uniform statewide collection list established under ORS 459A.914.

sections.value: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state polystyrene foam containers or polystyrene foam packaging peanuts.
sections.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state polystyrene foam containers or polystyrene foam packaging peanuts.

sections.value: A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.
sections.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

sections.value: The Department of Environmental Quality shall establish a certification program for compostable products.
sections.provenance: The Department of Environmental Quality shall establish a certification program for compostable products.

sections.value: The Environmental Quality Commission may adopt rules necessary to implement sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act.
sections.provenance: The Environmental Quality Commission may adopt rules necessary to implement sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act.

sections.value: The Department of Environmental Quality shall develop and implement a public education and awareness campaign to inform the public about the requirements of sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act.
sections.provenance: The Department of Environmental Quality shall develop and implement a public education and awareness campaign to inform the public about the requirements of sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act.
